note: WAEC Agricultural Science round 6 (R29 top-up): A-horizon eluviation, grey waterlogged subsoil, sand-clay-loam behaviour, humus, green manuring, compost turning; drip vs flood irrigation, drainage, fallowing, afforestation; photoperiodism, seed dressing, transplanting, hardening off, roguing, pruning, staking, weed competition; Panicum maximum, zero grazing, silage vs hay; rabbit hutches, pond plankton bloom, seine net, starter mash, Newcastle vaccination, queen bee; agro-processing, commodity boards, demonstration plot, secondary tillage. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Agric (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
